steps: Start in a straight-arm support on a pair of rings, with your arms locked by your sides.
Spread your legs wide apart into a straddle.
Turn the rings out, lean forward and slowly widen your straight arms to the sides as you lower your body toward horizontal.
Hold with your body horizontal near ring height, arms straight and wide, for the desired time.
Bring your arms back in and return to support.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
yd-3314.note: Started from ring support instead of a hang and lowered to the horizontal wide-arm hold; primary changed to shoulders.

steps: Place your hands on the floor or on parallettes wide of your hips, fingers turned out, and lie face down with your legs together.
Lock your elbows and lean forward so your shoulders move well past your hands.
Press down through your hands to lift your whole body off the floor, keeping it straight and horizontal close to the ground.
Hold this position on straight, wide arms for the desired time.
Lower your body back to the floor.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
yd-3315.note: Replaced the standing lean with the floor Maltese: straight wide arms by the hips, body horizontal near the floor; primary changed to shoulders.

steps: Place your hands on the floor slightly wider than shoulder-width apart, fingers turned out slightly.
Lock your elbows, lean your shoulders forward past your hands and lift your feet off the floor into a full planche, body straight and horizontal.
Keeping your feet off the floor, lower your body toward the ground by bending your elbows.
Continue lowering until your chest is just above the ground.
Push through your hands and extend your arms to return to the full planche.
Maintain a straight line from your head to your heels throughout the movement.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
yd-3327.note: Started and stayed in a full planche so the feet never touch down between reps.

steps: Grab the pull-up bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Hang with your arms fully extended, then raise your straight legs to hip height so your body forms an L.
Engage your lats and biceps to pull your body up towards the bar, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Continue pulling until your chin is above the bar, holding your legs in the L.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position, keeping the L.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
yd-3418.note: Added holding straight legs in an L at hip height through every rep.

steps: Sit on the floor with your legs extended in front of you.
Place your hands on the floor beside your hips, fingers pointing forward.
Lock your elbows, press your hands into the floor and push your shoulders down to lift your hips off the floor.
Lift your straight legs off the floor at the same time, holding them at hip height to form an 'L' shape.
Hold this position for the desired time.
Slowly lower your hips and legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
yd-3419.note: Added pressing through the hands to lift the hips off the floor.

steps: Lie on your back on the floor with both heels on a bench, knees bent and arms by your sides.
Press your arms into the floor for support.
Engage your glutes and hamstrings, then drive through your heels to lift your hips off the floor until your body forms a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
yd-3523.note: Fixed the incoherent setup: lying on the floor with both heels on the bench.

steps: Set an incline bench to a 45-degree angle and lie chest-down on it with a dumbbell in each hand, thumbs pointing up.
Let your arms hang straight down, keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms forward and up at about 45 degrees out from your head until they are in line with your body, forming a Y shape.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your arms back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
yd-3541.note: Made the setup chest-down and changed the lift to a Y path (forward and up at ~45 degrees) instead of out to the sides.

steps: Set an incline bench to a 45-degree angle and lie chest-down on it with a dumbbell in each hand, thumbs pointing up.
Let your arms hang straight down, perpendicular to the floor.
Keeping your arms straight, raise them out to the sides until they are parallel to the floor, forming a 'T' shape with your body.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your arms back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
yd-3542.note: Changed the seated lean to lying chest-down on the incline bench.

steps: Lie on your side next to a bench or box with your legs extended and stacked on top of each other.
Place your forearm on the bench directly below your shoulder, with your elbow bent at a 90-degree angle, so your body is angled up.
Engage your core and lift your hips off the ground, creating a straight line from your head to your feet.
Hold this position for the desired time.
Lower your hips back down, then switch sides.
yd-3544.note: Put the supporting forearm on an elevated bench.

steps: Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your body.
Keep your elbows close to your torso and your back straight.
Curl the dumbbell in your right hand to your shoulder with a neutral grip, keeping your upper arm stationary.
From the shoulder, press the dumbbell overhead until your arm is fully extended.
Lower the dumbbell back to your shoulder, then uncurl it to your side.
Repeat the curl and press with your left hand.
Continue alternating arms for the desired number of repetitions.
yd-3560.note: Joined the curl and press into one continuous movement per arm; dropped the breathing cues to keep it under 8 steps.

steps: Lie on your back on the floor with both heels on a bench, knees bent.
Place a barbell across your hips, holding it securely with both hands.
Engage your glutes and core, then drive through your heels to lift your hips off the floor until your knees, hips and shoulders are in line.
Pause for a moment at the top, squeezing your glutes.
Slowly lower your hips back down to the floor.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
yd-3562.note: Replaced the back-on-bench hip thrust with a floor bridge with both feet on the bench.

steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a single dumbbell in your left hand.
Take a step forward with your right foot, keeping your back straight and core engaged.
Lower your body by bending both knees until your right thigh is parallel to the ground.
Push through your right foot to return to the starting position.
Switch the dumbbell to your right hand and lunge forward with your left leg.
Alternate legs for the desired number of repetitions, always holding the dumbbell opposite the front leg.
yd-3635.note: Held a single dumbbell in the hand opposite the front leg, switching hands with legs.

steps: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands on the fronts of your thighs.
Engaging your abs, lift your shoulder blades off the ground and slide your hands up your thighs until your fingertips touch your knees.
Pause for a moment, then slowly lower back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
yd-3640.note: Swapped hands-behind-head for hands on the thighs sliding up to touch the knees, the common version.

steps: Kneel on both knees with your back straight, holding a weight in each hand with your arms extended straight down in front of you.
Step your right foot forward into a half-kneeling position.
Drive through your front foot to stand up, swinging the weights up and overhead with straight arms as you rise.
Lower the weights back down as you step back down to half-kneeling, then to both knees.
Repeat leading with your left foot.
Continue alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.
yd-3641.note: Added the step from kneeling to half-kneeling to standing, timed with the overhead swing, alternating legs.

steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Take a long step forward with your right foot, keeping your back straight.
Sink down into a deep lunge until your rear knee is just above the floor.
Pause at the bottom, sinking your hips forward to stretch the front of your rear hip.
Push through your front foot to return to the starting position.
Repeat with your left leg, continuing to alternate legs for the desired number of repetitions.
yd-3642.note: Added dumbbells and the long, deep lunge with a paused stretch at the bottom.

yd-3662.note: Agreed with the flag: primary changed from glutes to shoulders; steps already describe the flow and are kept.

yd-3666.note: Agreed equipment was wrong, but 'treadmill' is not an allowed value, so it is now 'machine'; steps kept.

steps: Lie on your side with your legs straight and your bottom arm under your head for support.
Bend your top leg and cross it over the bottom leg, planting that foot flat on the floor in front of your bottom knee.
Engage your adductors and lift your straight bottom leg toward the ceiling as high as you can without rotating your hips.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your leg back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
yd-3667.note: Lifted the bottom leg (adduction) instead of the top leg, with the top foot planted in front.

steps: Lie flat on a decline bench with your feet secured under the foot pads.
Hold a weight plate or dumbbell against your chest or behind your head.
Engage your abs and slowly lift your upper body off the bench, curling forward until your torso is perpendicular to the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
yd-3670.note: Added the held plate/dumbbell to step 2.

steps: Attach a rope handle to a cable pulley set at about face height when you are kneeling, and kneel facing the machine.
Grasp the rope with an overhand grip and extend your arms fully in front of you.
Keeping your back straight and core engaged, pull the rope towards your face, flaring your elbows out wide with your upper arms near shoulder height.
Squeeze your rear delts and shoulder blades at the end of the movement and hold for a brief pause.
Slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
yd-3697.note: Raised the pulley and added the wide-elbow pull toward the face that makes it a rear delt row.

steps: Adjust the handle height so the handles are at chest level, then stand facing away from the machine in a staggered stance.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip and position your hands at chest level.
Push the handles forward until your arms are fully extended, keeping your elbows slightly bent.
Pause for a moment, then slowly bring the handles back towards your chest, maintaining control throughout the movement.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
yd-3758.note: Replaced the seat adjustment with handle height and a standing staggered stance.

steps: Stand up straight and hold a single dumbbell vertically, cupping the underside of the top plate with both palms like a tray.
Keep your upper arms close to your body and your elbows tucked in.
Slowly curl the dumbbell up towards your shoulders, keeping it upright.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
yd-5201.note: Changed to one dumbbell held upright with both palms under the top plate.
